title: STILL HOUR — Summer homewear for sleeping and everyday living, 6 deliverables

config.text:
# STILL HOUR

- Project: Summer homewear for sleeping and everyday living
- Range: One short-sleeved top and one pair of shorts
- Size adaptations: Body A and Body B
- Size naming: Gender-neutral
- Uses: Reading, making breakfast, sleeping in summer
- Shared design features: Neckline family, sleeve type, pocket arrangement, openings, seam language, color placement
- Identification label text, line 1: STILL HOUR
- Identification label text, line 2: Summer homewear
- Label location: Inside the garment

## Bodies and fit

| Body | Standing height (mm) | Full chest (mm) | Natural waist (mm) | Full hip (mm) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Body A | 1600 | 920 | 800 | 1000 |
| Body B | 1850 | 1120 | 1000 | 1120 |

- Finished chest ease: 120–200 mm added to full body chest circumference
- Finished hip ease: 100–180 mm added to full body hip circumference
- Shorts relaxed waist: Below the corresponding natural waist circumference
- Shorts comfortably extended waist target: At least the corresponding natural waist circumference
- Designer-selected lengths: Top back length and shorts inseam for each size, in mm
- Body A pose: Standing, arms relaxed
- Body B poses: Seated, knees bent; side-lying, knees lightly bent
- Coverage: Waist covered by top and upper thighs covered by shorts in all three poses
- Pocket quantity: At least one garment pocket per size
- Folded reading cloth: 100 × 100 mm
- Pocket opening: At least 110 mm
- Usable pocket depth: At least 110 mm
- Skin-contact details: Inside seams, waist casing, identification/care label
- Hard-fitting placement: Clear of outer shoulder and outer hip side-lying contact areas

## Material and color

| ID | Composition | Structure | Mass | Role |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F1 | 100% cotton | plain weave | 125 g/m² | Main shell option |
| F2 | 95% cotton / 5% elastane | single jersey | 165 g/m² | Main shell option |
| T1 | Soft elastic tape | Fabric casing at skin contact | Designer-selected width in mm | Optional shorts waist adjustment |

- Main shell selection: One of F1 or F2 for both garments
- Final colorway: Two or three named colors, each with a six-digit hexadecimal code
- Color placement: Shared across both sizes
- Fabric identity image: F1 at left; F2 at right
- Source record date: 9 September 2026

# STILL HOUR — delivery catalog

This table lists every commissioned deliverable with its tier, file format and stage. What each deliverable must contain is stated in the commission letter.

| # | id | Deliverable | Tiers | Format and stage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | front-material-board | Front flat views and final material specification | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 2 | back-flat-board | Back flat views of both sizes | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 3 | construction-details | Pocket, dressing and skin-contact details | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 4 | body-a-standing | Body A standing at home | 6 | Format: PNG, 1600 by 2400 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 5 | body-b-seated | Body B seated at home | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 6 | body-b-side-lying | Body B side-lying at home | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |

# Summer homewear: bodies and use

## Range and use

- Garments: One short-sleeved top and one pair of shorts
- Wearers: Adults
- Activities: Reading, making breakfast, sleeping in summer
- Design identity: One shared design across two size adaptations
- Size adaptations: Body A and Body B
- Gender assignment: Both sizes gender-neutral
- Final colorways: One

## Body specifications

| Body | Standing height (mm) | Full chest circumference (mm) | Natural waist circumference (mm) | Full hip circumference (mm) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Body A | 1600 | 920 | 800 | 1000 |
| Body B | 1850 | 1120 | 1000 | 1120 |

- Circumference convention: Full horizontal body circumferences
- Dimensional source: Body table above
- body-and-pose-guide.png: Schematic measurement levels and pose locations
- Diagram geometry: Simplified body lines

## Garment fit targets

| Measurement | Body A | Body B |
|---|---|---|
| Finished full chest circumference | 1040–1120 mm | 1240–1320 mm |
| Finished full hip circumference | 1100–1180 mm | 1220–1300 mm |
| Shorts relaxed full waist circumference | Below 800 mm | Below 1000 mm |
| Shorts comfortably extended full waist circumference target | At least 800 mm | At least 1000 mm |
| Top back length | Designer-selected, mm | Designer-selected, mm |
| Shorts inseam | Designer-selected, mm | Designer-selected, mm |

- Chest ease: 120–200 mm above body chest circumference
- Hip ease: 100–180 mm above body hip circumference
- Measurement notation: Full circumferences distinguished from lengths
- Waist extension status: Proposed garment target
- Waist construction: Designer-selected casing and adjustment
- Closure type and elastic width: Open design decisions

## Movement and contact

| Body | Pose | Coverage |
|---|---|---|
| Body A | Standing with arms relaxed | Complete top and shorts; waist and upper thighs covered |
| Body B | Seated with knees bent | Complete top and shorts; waist and upper thighs covered |
| Body B | Side-lying with knees lightly bent | Complete top and shorts; waist and upper thighs covered |

- Shared features: Neckline family, sleeve type, pocket arrangement, openings, seam language, color placement
- Size-specific features: Fit adaptation, folds, natural drape, dimensioned pocket placement
- Side-lying direction: Either side
- Furniture: Any simple chair or bed
- Pocket quantity: At least one usable garment pocket per size
- Pocket contents: Soft reading cloth, 100 × 100 mm when folded
- Minimum pocket opening: 110 mm
- Minimum usable internal pocket depth: 110 mm
- Pocket location and construction: Open design decisions
- Reading cloth role: Activity context
- Dressing approach: Designer-selected top and shorts entry and removal, including pull-on options
- Contact surfaces: Inside seams, waist casing, identification/care label
- Hard fittings: Optional, positioned clear of outer shoulder and outer hip side-lying contact areas

## Open design decisions

- Silhouette
- Neckline
- Sleeve shape
- Hem shape
- Opening system
- Pocket location
- Surface graphics
- Seam arrangement
- Design starting point: Body measurements, use requirements and material options

# Summer homewear: material inputs

## Material options

| ID | Specification | Proposed role | Design characteristics |
|---|---|---|---|
| F1 | 100% cotton, plain weave, 125 g/m² | Main shell option | Woven construction; fit allowance supplied by garment dimensions |
| F2 | 95% cotton / 5% elastane, single jersey, 165 g/m² | Main shell option | Knit surface and supple drape |
| T1 | Soft elastic tape in a fabric casing; width chosen by the designer | Optional shorts waist adjustment | Fabric enclosure at skin contact; selected width recorded in mm |

- Material record type: Project material options
- Main shell selection: One option shared by top and shorts
- F1 and F2 relationship: Alternative main shells
- Bindings, pocket bags, facings and casing fabric: Selected main shell available for these uses
- Waist adjustment alternatives: T1 or another visible adjustment construction meeting the waist and contact targets
- Waist hardware: Open design decision

## Final colorway

- Colorway count: One
- Named color count: Two or three
- Color notation: Six-digit hexadecimal value for each named color
- Placement record: Named colors mapped to actual garment areas
- Size relationship: Same color placement on Body A and Body B
- View relationship: Shared color placement across six boards
- Rendering treatments: Natural light, shadow, printed-line drawings and enlarged construction views
- Monochrome technical views: Color keys linked to the final material specification

## Material specification fields

- Chosen shell ID: F1 or F2
- Composition: Corresponding table entry
- Fabric structure: Corresponding table entry
- Mass: Corresponding table entry
- Garment use: Top and shorts
- Swatch type: Schematic illustration of the selected specification
- Color key: Named colors, hexadecimal values and garment-area mapping
- Optional T1 fields: Selected width and encased location
- Comfort-oriented design features: Fit allowance, contact-surface treatment and adjustment construction

steps.userMessage:
STILL HOUR | Summer homewear for sleeping and everyday living

We need one short-sleeved top and one pair of shorts for adults who move between reading, making breakfast and sleeping in the same summer outfit. Develop one design in two size adaptations, with a shared neckline family, sleeve type, pocket arrangement, openings and seam language. Body A is 1600 mm tall, with chest, waist and hip circumferences of 920, 800 and 1000 mm. Body B is 1850 mm tall, with corresponding circumferences of 1120, 1000 and 1120 mm. Both sizes belong to the same gender-neutral range. Show Body A standing with arms relaxed, and Body B both seated with knees bent and side-lying with knees lightly bent. The top must cover the waist and the shorts must cover the upper thighs in all three poses.

Choose one shell for both garments: F1, 100% cotton, plain weave, 125 g/m²; or F2, 95% cotton / 5% elastane, single jersey, 165 g/m². Set one final colorway using two or three named colors with six-digit hexadecimal codes and consistent placement across both sizes. Provide at least one garment pocket for a folded 100 × 100 mm reading cloth, with an opening and usable internal depth each at least 110 mm. Resolve dressing, waist adjustment and the inside surfaces together; place any hard fittings clear of the outer shoulder and outer hip contact areas during side-lying. Print "STILL HOUR" and "Summer homewear" on an inside identification label, with both lines legible on the construction details board.

Audience: our clothing design team and sample maker, for selecting the summer outfit and preparing its first samples.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md records the range identity and fixed project facts. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the six deliverables with their proportions, formats and stages. bodies-and-use.en.md supplies the body measurements, fit targets and wearing situations. materials.en.md supplies the two shell options and optional waist elastic. body-and-pose-guide.png is the constraint image locating body measurement levels and the three poses. material-swatches.png is the identity image for the two available fabric surfaces. summer-living-room.png is the atmosphere reference for the home setting and evening light.

Deliverables:
1. One front flat-view and material specification board, with the complete top and shorts in both sizes, finished garment measurements, the chosen shell specification, a schematic swatch and the final color-placement key
2. One back flat-view board, with the complete top and shorts in both sizes, top back lengths, shorts inseams and rear seam and pocket placement
3. One construction details board covering both sizes, with dimensioned pocket openings, usable depths and positions, dressing and waist adjustment, inside seam finishes, waist casing and the identification label
4. One standing home image of Body A wearing the complete outfit with arms relaxed
5. One seated home image of Body B wearing the complete outfit with knees bent
6. One side-lying home image of Body B wearing the complete outfit with knees lightly bent

Acceptance:
- The front and back boards show the same top and shorts in both sizes. On the front board, label finished full chest circumference within 1040–1120 mm for Body A and 1240–1320 mm for Body B, and finished full hip circumference within 1100–1180 mm for Body A and 1220–1300 mm for Body B. State each size's chosen top back length and shorts inseam in mm on both boards.
- The front and construction details boards state relaxed and comfortably extended full waist circumferences for each size: relaxed below 800 mm and extended at least 800 mm for Body A; relaxed below 1000 mm and extended at least 1000 mm for Body B. The details board explains the top and shorts dressing approach and shows the corresponding adjustment construction; any T1 elastic has its width in mm and its enclosing casing shown.
- The construction details board dimensions at least one garment pocket per size with an opening and usable internal depth each at least 110 mm. Dimension its position separately for Body A and Body B, and match its placement and construction on the front board, back board and three wearing images wherever visible.
- The construction details board shows the inside seam finish, waist contact surface and label attachment, with "STILL HOUR" and "Summer homewear" legible on the label. Its fitting placement and the side-lying image keep any hard fittings clear of the outer shoulder and outer hip contact areas.
- The front board states the selected F1 or F2 composition, structure and mass as listed in this letter, identifies its use on both garments, and names two or three colors with six-digit hexadecimal codes. All six boards use that color placement; monochrome technical views carry keys to the same named colors.
- The standing, seated and side-lying images show the complete outfit in the three specified poses, with waist and upper-thigh coverage. Across these images and the flat views, preserve the neckline family, sleeve type, openings and seam arrangement, while showing the separately dimensioned size adaptations through pocket placement, garment proportions and pose-specific folds.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
